name: Ohio State Summer 2024

organisers.name: The Rubik's Cube Club at Ohio State

information:
This competition takes place after [FMC 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMC2024), which goes from 6:00am EST to 10:30am EST. To sign up for that competition, visit the website [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMC2024/register) and list the location as "Columbus" if you plan on going to the Columbus location.

The main events for this competition take place on Sunday, Saturday afternoon will just be for 4BLD, 5BLD, and MBLD. Please only come on Saturday if you are participating in 4BLD, 5BLD, or MBLD, or wish to help us with those events which would be appreciated.
